summary.zh: 以挑刺视角审查改动，找出被忽视的风险
summary.en: Harsh pre-merge review that hunts shared blind spots

description.zh: 在合并前用对抗视角把改动拆开看，专门找团队共同忽视的漏洞、边界情况和设计捷径。适合自评过于顺利、想要一份不留情面的第二意见时使用。
description.en: Takes a change apart before merge, targeting what a team collectively overlooks: edge cases, failure paths and design shortcuts. Use it when your own review felt too agreeable.
